{"explanation":"This query counts the number of distinct people who have consented to be emailed (email_ok = true) and have a recent move event detected in the last 90 days from the fct_life_events table with high or medium confidence.","refuse":"","sql":"SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT maa.person_key) AS emailable_recent_movers
